# Sandweave

> Linux sandboxes for agent training and evaluation. Python and CLI access to code, desktops, VR games, and distributed workers without host sudo or KVM.

## Get started
- [Introduction](https://pranjal2041.github.io/sandweave/)
- [Installation](https://pranjal2041.github.io/sandweave/installation/)
- [Your first sandbox](https://pranjal2041.github.io/sandweave/quickstart/)
